Subject: Re: Freelance Project Contract

Hi Eliana,

Thanks for reviewing the contract and for your feedback. I appreciate you bringing these points up so we can ensure the terms work well for both of us.

Regarding the payment terms, I understand your preference for net-30. Let me check with our finance team to see if we can accommodate a net-30 structure for this project, or perhaps meet in the middle with net-45. I will get back to you on this shortly.

As for the non-compete clause, I agree that it should be equitable. We can certainly discuss adjusting the scope or duration to make it more reasonable. Let’s schedule a brief call later this week to go over both points in detail.

Best regards,

Ms. Adams
